textTemplates.name: FrankingExpirein30Days
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Name}, Warm Greetings from Panchshil!
This is a gentle reminder that the Franking Challan for your unit at {!$Record.EYI_Project_Enquired__r.Name} is due to expire in the next 30 days.
Franking Details: • Customer Name: {!$Record.Name} • Project Name: {!$Record.EYI_Project_Enquired__r.Name} • Unit Number: {!$Record.EYI_Inventory__c} • Franking Completion Date: {!$Record.EYI_Franking_Received_Date__c}
To avoid the challan becoming invalid, we strongly recommend that you initiate your registration process at the earliest.
Important Note: In case of non-adherence, the responsibility of reinitiating the process, including obtaining a new Franking Challan if required, will lie with the customer.
Thank you once again for choosing Panchshil. Please do not hesitate to reach out to us should you have any further queries or require additional assistance.
Best Regards, Panchshil Realty

textTemplates.name: RegRescheduledBody
textTemplates.text:
Dear {!$Record.Name}, Warm Greetings from Panchshil!
As per your request, we have rescheduled your registration appointment to the next available slot. Kindly find the updated details below:
Updated Registration Details: • Customer Name: {!$Record.Name} • Project Name: {!$Record.EYI_Project_Enquired__r.Name} • Unit Number: {!$Record.EYI_Inventory__r.Name} • New Scheduled Date & Time: {!$Record.EYI_Registration_Scheduled_Date__c}
For a smooth and seamless experience, we encourage you to review the attached Dos and Don’ts for the Registration Process before your visit.
Important Note: While we aim to provide a seamless registration experience, delays at the registrar’s office may occasionally occur due to administrative processing. We appreciate your patience in such cases.
Thank you once again for choosing Panchshil. Please do not hesitate to reach out to us should you have any further queries or require additional assistance.
Best Regards, Panchshil Realty

Thank you once again for choosing Panchshil. Please don't hesitate to reach out to us should you have any further questions or require additional support.
Best regards, Panchshil Team
